brand.name: Unmissed
brand.what: The AI front desk for owner-run businesses
brand.audience: owners of small, owner-run businesses in Toronto who are too busy serving customers to answer every enquiry

idea: A day and a night in the life of a busy owner (invent the business: a family bakery). Hands in dough, phone buzzing unseen. A late-night website enquiry is answered in seconds, signed by the bakery. The owner sees the alert on their phone the next morning, smiles, and keeps working. A customer leaves happy; a polite review request arrives. Calm, warm, human. The technology stays invisible: we see its effect on a real-feeling day.
allowed_claims: every website enquiry answered in seconds, day and night, signed by the business
the owner alerted on their phone, and one polite follow-up
every customer marked done asked for a review within 24 hours
the owner owns every account and approves what goes live

end_card.cta: You own it. You approve it. We prove it.

notes: Invented people, modest wardrobe. Phone screens show soft abstract UI shapes, never readable text. No prices, no URL, no testimonials, no numbers of clients.
